# Allowed permissions for EVProfile.
# Any uses-permission in a manifest NOT listed here FAILS the CI.
# Why: the app runs on a moving vehicle — any new permission
# (especially network or vehicle-write) must be reviewed and added here explicitly.
# One line = one full permission name. '#' = comment.

android.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
# Required by foregroundServiceType="connectedDevice" from API 34 onward (T-910).
# Grants no additional access; it classifies the foreground service.
android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE
android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
# Posts the foreground-service notification, the only visible sign EVProfile is running.
android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS
android.permission.RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED
android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS
android.permission.BLUETOOTH
android.permission.BLUETOOTH_CONNECT
android.car.permission.CAR_ENERGY
android.car.permission.CAR_POWERTRAIN
android.car.permission.CAR_VENDOR_EXTENSION
android.car.permission.CONTROL_CAR_CLIMATE
# --- permission DECLARED by the app (not requested) ---
# Required from the hard-key broadcast sender with protectionLevel="signature" (T-902):
# only an app signed with the platform key can obtain it. It restricts access and does
# not grant any.
com.evsuite.profile.permission.RECEIVE_HARDKEY
# External control API: signature-level permission protecting ProfileControlService.
# protectionLevel="signature": reserved for apps signed with the platform key.
# Declared and requested by EVProfile so it can send the broadcast.
com.evsuite.profile.permission.CONTROL_PROFILES
# --- network / OTA (unstable channel only; the merged-manifest gate proves stable lacks it) ---
android.permission.INTERNET
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
